# logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits (Resource)

Manages the AI Gateway spending limits of one project. When the project goes over a limit, the Gateway blocks every credential in the project until the window resets. Requires a plan that includes the AI Gateway and a token with `organization:read_gateway` and `organization:write_gateway` scopes (`organization:read` and `organization:write` are also accepted).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Cap the Gateway spend of one project. A window you omit has no limit.
resource "logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits" "example" {
  project_id  = logfire_project.example.id
  weekly_usd  = 200
  monthly_usd = 1000
}
```

## Ownership

The resource owns all three windows. A window you omit has no limit, and
destroying the resource removes every limit of the project.

Creating the resource replaces any limits set in the Logfire UI. To keep them,
import the resource first and copy the imported values into your configuration.

## Deleted or inaccessible projects

The API answers a deleted project and a project the token cannot reach with the
same access error. The provider then lists the projects the token can see. A
project missing from that list counts as deleted: refresh removes the limits from
state and destroy succeeds, because the limits went with the project. A project
that is still listed keeps the error on refresh and destroy, and the next plan
recovers without a change when access returns.

A token that loses access to a project also stops seeing it in the list, so its
limits leave state as if the project were deleted. The next apply then fails to
recreate them with the access error. When access returns, import the limits again.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The UUID of the project that the limits apply to. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `daily_usd` (Number) The daily limit in whole US dollars. A day starts at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no daily limit.
- `monthly_usd` (Number) The monthly limit in whole US dollars. A month starts on the 1st at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no monthly limit.
- `weekly_usd` (Number) The weekly limit in whole US dollars. A week starts on Monday at 00:00 UTC. Omit it to have no weekly limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project UUID.

## Import

Import the limits of a project by the lowercase project UUID:

```terraform
import {
  to = logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits.example
  id = "018f45c0-3cab-7b2f-a8f7-8a0b55a7ed00"
}
```

Or use the command line:

```shell
# Import the spending limits of a project by the project UUID.
terraform import 'logfire_gateway_project_spending_limits.example' "018f45c0-3cab-7b2f-a8f7-8a0b55a7ed00"
```
